svg.title: Known-best packing of 299 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=299 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-18 exact rational centre-direction certificate at 299, read exactly from the retained source file n299/n299_exact.json at 497eb47, in the watched repository JoostdeWinter/square-packing, which jlevy/squares#1031 names: diagonal slices from published packings of 372 and 335 squares, locally optimized, with part of one tilted group reflected across the diagonal. Finite construction feasibility only; local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=299 known best: side ~ 17.79363699 (certified upper bound)
